businessGoal: Enable users to sort products by various criteria.

scenarios.goal: Verify that sorting dropdown is displayed on the product overview page.
Verify that the sort dropdown includes all specified options (Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Price High-Low, Price Low-High).
Verify that selecting a sort option reloads the product grid with products sorted correctly.

manual.reason: The story describes UI elements and user interactions that can be tested manually.

api.reason: There are no mentions of an API for sorting behavior in the given story.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria involve visible browser behaviors and dropdown interactions.
